description: This file defines a question generator agent using a state machine workflow built with the langgraph library. It includes classes for managing question generation state, building the workflow graph, and methods for generating single or multiple questions asynchronously, with validation and conditional regeneration logic.

classes.name: QuestionState
classes.description: TypedDict schema representing the state of the question generation workflow

classes.name: QuestionGeneratorAgent
classes.description: Agent class that manages question generation workflow, including graph building, validation, and batch processing

methods.name: _build_graph
methods.description: Constructs the state machine workflow for question generation

methods.name: _should_regenerate
methods.description: Decision function to determine if question generation should be retried based on validation results

methods.name: generate_single_question
methods.description: Asynchronously generates a single validated question for a given chapter and difficulty

methods.name: generate_batch_questions
methods.description: Generates multiple questions concurrently in batches, with a limit on maximum concurrency
